svg.title: Sum over the V anchors. Since each exponential is at least one, P α aα ≤V u. This proves absolute summability of the derivative envelopes, including derivatives in any fixed finite list of directions: divide those directions by one common scalar until they satisfy the threshold bound, apply (RB8), then multiply by that scalar to the derivative order. The same scalar works for every address. Termwise differentiation on the strict healthy open set therefore follows from uniform absolute convergence of the derivative series through order k. Changing every anchor to the one in the common listing multiplies its envelope by at most Kanc = ((1 + D)p)k, as in (RB5). On this fixed torus,
